sheets.title: ELECTRICAL ONE-LINE DIAGRAM — COLONNA WELDING SHOP 2000A SERVICE
sheets.reading_notes: Single-page one-line diagram showing the complete 480/277V 4W distribution system for the Colonna Welding Shop. Utility source (Dominion) feeds a 2000A MCB panel at 480V. From the 2000A main panel, loads branch to: 600A PNL, three automation train circuits (W1, W2, W3 — each 60A), W12 (60A), W13 (60A), HYD MECH (30A), 400A PNL (480/277V), 100A SW1 (100AF heavy-duty switch), 75A SW2 (75AF, sub arc train), EX SERVICE 3-PH 200A, 100A SW2 (100AF), T1 50KVA transformer (480→277V), TNEW 75KVA transformer (480→277V), and IRONWORKER (10hp motor). Transformers T1 and TNEW step down to 277V feeding EX PNL 200A and NEW 200A PNL respectively. Legend identifies wire types A through K and conduit sizing. All wire is copper 3-wire+ground. Sheet is stamped by a Virginia PE (signature visible, license number partially legible). Title block lists two office addresses: Norfolk, VA 23502 and Alexandria, VA 22312. Project No. 21-010. Scale: AS NOTED. Contract No.: blank (not filled in).
